verdict.rationale: A data-use or privacy posture on AI training is a fair question for any service that collects user data, including a government filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-facing opt-out and no policy on whether submitted data is used to train AI models. The filing host's robots.txt does block named AI crawlers, but that is a site-level crawler control rather than a user's ability to keep their data out of model training, so it earns no credit.
